issues.where: Topology.lean:1502-1510 and 2053-2071 (btzJCausality); SCOPE (a); REPORT.json rem hypotheses[1] ('carried')
issues.problem: Two residues of the causality construction are asserted in prose, not proved or ruled. (i) At points of Δ (no 𝐌³-chart) the local relation is taken to be the ambient order of 𝐌³; DEC-33 speaks of 'the charts' local causality' and no ruling names the local causality at singular points of \widetilde{BTZ}. The choice is the natural one (any alternative not constraining curves on Δ would let a T_BTZ-continuous curve slide to the past along Δ), it is disclosed in SCOPE (a), and it matches the accepted GX.E0.causality — but the REPORT row calls it 'carried' rather than a reading and drops AUDIT-2's question to the author. (ii) Nothing proves that btzJCausality restricted to J⁺(Δ)∖Δ is Minkowski's (staticCausality) causality there, i.e. that the identity chart is a ChartIso (the 'generated by the charts' half of DEC-33); the global order is proved, which is all the remark uses, so the certified statement is not affected.
issues.fix: Record (i) as a finding (or keep a question) stating the axis-point local relation and its WP-41e precedent; optionally prove (ii) as `ChartIso` / agreement on the open set btzJReg x₀ (nhds_btzJ_of_mem_reg gives the topologies; curves of a convex open subset coincide), or disclose it in SCOPE as owned by WP-39f together with the E0.causality identification.
